podcast.title: Meeting Will Smith (1994)
podcast.body: She met Will Smith on the set of "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air" in 1994, and they married three years later. "She met Will Smith, you know him, on the set of The Fresh Prince of Bel Air in 1994. Three years later, they were married..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Formation (2002)
podcast.body: Jada Pinkett Smith was a member of the metal band Wicked Wisdom around 2002, during the period she was raising her children Jaden and Willow. "And as she was being mummed to Jaden and Willow, she was in a metal band called Wicked Wisdom. This was back in 2002."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: "Showbiz Kids" Documentary Interviewee
podcast.body: Jada Pinkett Smith was among the child stars interviewed for the HBO documentary "Showbiz Kids." "One of the people interviewed for that doc was Jada Pinkett Smith."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Extensive Acting Career
podcast.body: Jada Pinkett Smith had a prolific acting career in films and television shows from a young age. "She was in a ton of films and TV shows growing up."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Parents' Musical Background
xref.body: Willow is the daughter of Will Smith, a rapper, and Jada Pinkett Smith, who is a singer for the new metal band Wicked Wisdom, indicating a strong musical lineage. "She's the daughter of Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith, two people have had their own music careers. Will is a rapper, of course, and mom is a singer of a new metal band called Wicked Wisdom."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
